interpretation: Development action qualification; no efficacy, heterogeneity or power claim from eight problems/two repeats. Historical v1 is not a randomized budget comparator.
enrollment: Fixed eight fresh problems; retain ineligible states, no replacements, no success-based checkpoint selection.
continuation: Same seed per problem/repeat across actions; shared RNG number is not a variance reduction guarantee. Randomized execution order.
gate: Inspect complete enrollment, treatment integrity, total costs, task difficulty and informative failure modes before a separately specified replication. No automatic best-action promotion.
